title: The Last Ferry
logline: A retired mechanic races to catch the last ferry of the night to return a locket to the man who left her forty years ago, before he is gone for good.
content:
FADE IN:

EXT. HARBOUR PIER - DUSK

Wind whips sea spray across a deserted wooden pier. A single ferry, lights blazing, idles at the far end.

MARA (60s), wiry, grey-streaked braid, oil-stained work jacket, hurries down the planks clutching a brass locket.

FERRYMAN (O.S.)
Last crossing! Now or never!

MARA
(breathless)
Wait. Please wait.

INT. FERRY CABIN - CONTINUOUS

Warm tungsten light. Rows of empty benches. JONAS (60s), broad-shouldered, flat cap, sits alone by a spray-streaked window.

Mara stops in the doorway. Jonas looks up. Neither speaks.

She opens her hand: the locket. He takes it, opens it, and his face breaks into a slow smile.

JONAS
You kept it.

MARA
Forty years. You're late.

The ferry horn sounds. Through the window, the pier lights slide away.

FADE OUT.
notes: Set in an unnamed northern harbour at dusk; names Mara and Jonas are my choice.
The ferryman stays off screen to keep the cast at two on camera.
